scenario: Shared Lane, N=3, CONFIG_01, HARDWARE, repeat 2
2a_method: schedule feasibility: a conflict makes its tasks infeasible only if the negotiation ended unresolved AND no participant established a new itinerary within 5.0s (replan recovery)
2a_method_conflict_free: conflict-free scheduling rate = itineraries that did not trigger a negotiation / all itineraries; an itinerary triggered one when its participant is in a negotiation_notice and it is that participant's most recent itinerary at or before the notice
2b_method: planner compute = bid_response - bid_notice (one per task, bounds rmf_task::TaskPlanner); schedule confirm = query_update_1 - itinerary_set (one per itinerary, contains no planning). 2b_scheduling_time_s is the schedule-confirm figure under its original key, kept so metrics files already written stay readable
